content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for TMC OT Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) post at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 14 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the OT Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 12th standard in Science, followed by a B.Sc degree with a certificate or diploma in OT. Additionally, one year of post-qualification internship or work experience in the relevant field is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the OT Technician position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the OT Technician role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 23,870/- to Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the OT Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) post at the Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the OT Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test (MCQ), followed by a Skill Test, Interview, and Document Verification. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Sangrur, Punjab. The specific venue address will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) position at Tata Memorial Centre is a contractual job.
